cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I approve another overnight visit, tell me which towel I'm using.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Local supply approved. The guest towel, or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. Are you inspecting my bathroom now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm settling the arrangements. When I leave, may that hook remain reserved for me, or are you requesting that I join the guest laundry?

reason: A turns hospitality into an inspection-like approval sequence; B notices the presumption, and A uses the unchanged hook to probe future belonging without a relationship label.
